bio.text: Nanette Barragán was elected to the U.S. House in November 2016 and represents California's 44th Congressional District, becoming the first Latina to represent it.
She was born and raised in the Harbor Gateway area and earned an undergraduate degree from UCLA and a J.D. from the USC Gould School of Law.
She worked in the Clinton White House Office of Public Liaison and for the NAACP, and served on the Hermosa Beach City Council, including as mayor.
She is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
